# domainchief_mail_forward (Resource)

Manages a mail forward of a domain that uses Domain Chief hosted DNS.

Mail forwarding must already be enabled for the domain, the provider does not enable it because it is a paid feature. Requires a token with the `domainchief:redirects_mail:write` scope.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Mail forwarding must already be enabled for the domain.
resource "domainchief_mail_forward" "info" {
  domain = "example.com"
  alias  = "info"
  target = "team@example.net"
}

# Forward every address without its own mail forward.
resource "domainchief_mail_forward" "catch_all" {
  domain = "example.com"
  alias  = "*"
  target = "inbox@example.net"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `alias` (String) The local part to forward, for example `info` for `info@example.com`. Use `*` to forward every address that has no other mail forward.
- `domain` (String) The domain name or domain ID the mail forward belongs to. Changing this creates a new mail forward.
- `target` (String) The email address that receives the forwarded messages.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of the mail forward.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Mail forwards are imported using the domain and the mail forward ID.
terraform import domainchief_mail_forward.info example.com/01HXYZ0000000000000000000
```
